BETA Close X Ninety One PLC has announced the repurchase of 1,051,771 ordinary shares for a total cost of £2,277,300.28 between June 8th and June 12th, 2026, as part of its ongoing share buyback program. Following these transactions, the company holds no shares in treasury, and its total issued ordinary shares now stand at 667,620,629.
